text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from a little road trip 
with Cheval Grand—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list:
If you're sleepy, you can go ahead and 
sleep.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It'll be quite a while before we reach the 
station nearest the academy. I tell her to 
get some sleep, promising to wake her up 
when we arrive.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I'm sorry... Just a little bit, 
then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand sleeping soundly. Riding the 
swaying train, we spent some quiet time 
together—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —Trai-ner...! —U-Um, T-Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, u-u-um, excuse me, I fell asleep just 
now too...! Um... this is the last stop...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final stop—an unfamiliar rural town. 
Apparently only special local trains come 
this far, and the next train heading back 
won't leave for another three hours...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As far as the eye could see, there were 
only rice fields, mountains, and the 
horizon. There wasn't even a shop to kill 
time in... It's my own fault for dozing 
off alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "U-Um... I-I fell asleep too, so..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ――... Ah, the scent of the tide...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Um, over there, the sea... 
......W-Would you like to go check it 
out...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking around, there appeared to be a 
sandy beach within walking distance. 
Feeling a bit guilty, I followed her 
suggestion and headed toward the sea.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crashhhh...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What an enormous blunder. Because of my 
own thoughtlessness, I've ended up 
squandering Cheval Grand's precious time 
like this...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I found... a pretty seashell.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, that one over there too... Hehe, what 
a funny shape... looks like a bamboo 
shoot...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand picks up various seashells 
and shows them to me. Perhaps she's trying 
to cover for me so I don't beat myself up 
over my mistake.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Th-There's an incredible-looking 
stone here, too...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please take a look. This is 
incredible...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —Eh?
choice_data_list: Sorry, thanks for covering for me, too.

I'm sorry, thanks for backing me up like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... N-No, that's not... It's not... 
like that..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I... like quiet seas like this... This 
beach is pretty, and there are lots of 
different seashells, too..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It's not about covering for you or 
anything... It's just, I thought it'd be 
nice to visit an unfamiliar beach once in 
a while...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
“—Th-This strange stone too...! You don't 
find things like this often... It's only 
because we happened to come to this 
beach... that's why...”

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, it was totally my gain. 
...Ehehe."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand's face broke into a happy 
smile. Her gentle, pure-hearted nature 
somehow made me feel saved.
choice_data_list:
Shell collecting, huh... Maybe I'll join 
in.

Shell collecting, huh... Maybe I'll join 
in too.
Wanna make a sandcastle or something?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand's face broke into a happy 
smile. Her gentle, pure-hearted nature 
somehow made me feel saved.
choice_data_list:
Shell collecting, huh... Maybe I'll join 
in.

Shell collecting, huh... Maybe I'll join 
in too.
Wanna make a sandcastle or something?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... y-yes... um, gladly...
choice_data_list:
I wonder if I can do something with this 
if I take it home.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —! U-Um... just as an example, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
You could put them in little bottles and 
decorate your room, or... I-I think you 
could do things like that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we gathered lots of seashells 
to take home— and the two of us crafted 
small bottled souvenirs together.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: A castle...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately... if you could call it that, 
we have plenty of time. It looks like we 
can aim for a true masterpiece.
choice_data_list: What kind of castle should we make?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh— Um, umm...! A masterpiece... a, a 
gigantic castle...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, um, for now, I'll go gather some wet 
sand from the water...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of us got absorbed in 
building a sandcastle— and the long wait 
passed by in the blink of an eye.
